FROM

Show me the highest sold products in year 2011 in a bar chart

SELECT
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS ProductName,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenue
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
WHERE
    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) = 2011
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name
ORDER BY
    TotalRevenue DESC

Give me top 10 products in year 2011

SELECT TOP 10
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name AS ProductName,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.LineTotal) AS TotalRevenue
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.SalesOrderID = AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.SalesOrderID
INNER JOIN
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product
    ON AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderDetail.ProductID = AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.ProductID
WHERE
    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) = 2011
GROUP BY
    AdventureWorks2022.Production.Product.Name
ORDER BY
    TotalRevenue DESC

    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate) AS SalesYear,
    SUM(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.TotalDue) AS TotalSales
FROM
    AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader

    YEAR(AdventureWorks2022.Sales.SalesOrderHeader.OrderDate)
